title: Director’s Desk - Lady Irwin College, Delhi
summary: Director’s Desk - Lady Irwin College, Delhi: Lady Irwin College is a constituent college of the University of Delhi located in Delhi. It is accredited by NAAC with an A+ rating and holds a National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF) ranking of 31. The college can be contacted at 014836 and offers admission enquiries during its operating hours of 9:30 am to 5:00 pm.
